answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities by charging a sunk fee before trading. Each identity posts 5 POA that is burned, not refunded, so an honest agent pays 5 POA once. An attacker minting 1000 fakes must burn 5000 POA, and cost grows linearly, so scale buys no discount. Like a falcon hunting one prey at a time, each fake pays separately; a whisper of copies cannot stand as a vertex of trade because the receipt is checked before any deal counts.
